value.rationale: Part (v) is an equivalence intended to characterize weak disjointness, but its printed condition is not invariant under changing a continuous g-frame on a null set, while weak disjointness is. The two Parseval families in the counterexample are indistinguishable from constant coefficient families in L2 yet pass the pointwise test. The repair is exact, representation-invariant, and aligns the theorem with the operator-space structure used throughout continuous frame theory.
